name: tods-competition-factory
author: Charles Allen <charles@CourtHive.com> (CourtHive.com)
description: Create and mutate TODS compliant tournament objects

scripts.release:alpha: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i premajor --preid alpha) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.minor:alpha: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i preminor --preid alpha) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.patch:alpha: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i prerelease --preid alpha) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:beta: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i prerelease --preid beta) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.minor:beta: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i preminor --preid beta) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.patch:beta: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i prerelease --preid beta) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i major) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i minor) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release:patch: npm run commits && npm version $(semver $npm_package_version -i patch) && git push && git push --tags
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/generateEnumConstants.mjs && node scripts/generateEnumExports.mjs && node scripts/generateEngineMethods.mjs && node scripts/generateMethodSignatures.mjs
scripts.corpus:manifest: pnpm corpus:authored && pnpm corpus:scheduling && pnpm corpus:grammar && pnpm corpus:scoring && pnpm corpus:mocks && pnpm corpus:queue && node scripts/verify/corpus-manifest.mjs --write
scripts.kernel:harvest-scheduling: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('.kernel-cases',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('.kernel-cases')" && SCHEDULING_PLAN_CASES=.kernel-cases/scheduling.jsonl SCHEDULING_SCALE=1 TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/corpus/schedulingSources.test.ts src/tests/corpus/schedulingScale.test.ts src/tests/mutations/scheduling --testTimeout=3600000
scripts.corpus:scheduling-scale: SCHEDULING_SCALE=1 CORPUS_OUT=.corpus-out/scheduling-scale TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/corpus/schedulingScale.test.ts --testTimeout=3600000
scripts.corpus:scoring: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.corpus-out/scoring',{recursive:true,force:true})" && CORPUS_OUT=.corpus-out/scoring CORPUS_CONFORMANCE_OUT=.corpus-out/scoring TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/corpus/scoringSource.test.ts src/tests/corpus/scoringTimeline.test.ts src/tests/scoring/conformance
scripts.corpus:grammar:harvest: CORPUS_GRAMMAR_HARVEST=1 CORPUS_OUT=.corpus-out/grammar TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/corpus/grammarSource.test.ts
scripts.corpus:verify: pnpm corpus:fixtures && pnpm corpus:oracles && pnpm corpus:record && pnpm corpus:grammar:harvest && pnpm corpus:scoring && pnpm corpus:authored && pnpm corpus:scheduling && pnpm corpus:mocks && pnpm corpus:queue && pnpm corpus:coverage && node scripts/verify/corpus-coverage.mjs
scripts.lint:report: eslint src & eslint --cache src -f json > eslint-report.json
scripts.docs:publish: cd documentation && GIT_USER=CourtHive USE_SSH=true pnpm docpub
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:generated && pnpm verify:lockfile && pnpm verify:types && pnpm verify:lint && pnpm verify:format && pnpm verify:exit-tenant && pnpm verify:outcome-spec && pnpm verify:corpus-manifest && pnpm verify:migration-coverage && pnpm verify:attr-audit && pnpm verify:coverage && pnpm verify:coverage-headroom && pnpm verify:route-differential && pnpm verify:deep-corrections && pnpm verify:hydrations && pnpm verify:team-arms && pnpm verify:server && pnpm verify:audit && pnpm verify:build && pnpm verify:publint && pnpm verify:runtime && pnpm verify:shakeable && pnpm verify:bundle-size && pnpm verify:consumer-bundle && pnpm verify:surface && pnpm verify:docs-examples && pnpm verify:docs-imports && pnpm verify:docs-methods && pnpm verify:pack
scripts.verify:generated: pnpm check:enum-constants && pnpm check:enum-exports && pnpm check:governors && pnpm check:engine-methods && pnpm check:method-signatures && pnpm check:request-shapes:self-test && pnpm check:request-shapes && pnpm verify:any-count --self-test && pnpm verify:any-count && pnpm verify:constant-names && pnpm verify:docs-model && pnpm verify:engine-api-transition
scripts.verify:types: node_modules/typescript7/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json && node scripts/verify/tscRatchet.mjs --self-test && pnpm verify:implicit-any && pnpm verify:hard-union && pnpm verify:shadowed-types
scripts.verify:corpus-manifest: pnpm corpus:authored && pnpm corpus:scheduling && pnpm corpus:grammar && pnpm corpus:scoring && pnpm corpus:mocks && pnpm corpus:queue && node scripts/verify/corpus-manifest.mjs
scripts.verify:hydrations: PIPELINE_HYDRATIONS=1 OUTCOME_PIPELINE=v1 TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/mutations/exitPropagation/pipelineCost.test.ts && PIPELINE_HYDRATIONS=1 OUTCOME_PIPELINE=v2 TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/mutations/exitPropagation/pipelineCost.test.ts && PIPELINE_HYDRATIONS=1 OUTCOME_PIPELINE=differential TZ=UTC vitest run src/tests/mutations/exitPropagation/pipelineCost.test.ts
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify:generated && pnpm verify:lockfile && pnpm verify:build && pnpm verify:publint && pnpm verify:runtime && pnpm verify:shakeable && pnpm verify:bundle-size && pnpm verify:consumer-bundle && pnpm verify:surface && pnpm verify:pack
